--
name: issue-review
description: Review a GitHub Issue for clarity and readiness
before implementation. Use when asked to review an issue.--
# Issue review
1. Read the issue content provided in the chat.
2. Identify its goal and acceptance criteria.
3. Check whether the issue is clear and small enough.
4. Check dependencies and missing information.
5. Suggest up to three specific improvements.
6. Recommend Ready or Backlog, with a short reason.
Do not change files, code, issues or project status.
Do not claim to have read an issue if its text is unavailable.
The student makes the final decision.
